about_short_description.short_description: Fintoc is an API that lets online businesses accept instant payments coming directly from the customer’s bank account.

product.name: Iniciación de Pagos (Payment Initiation)
product.description: An API-driven service enabling businesses to accept instant payments directly from customers' bank accounts with lower transaction fees than card payments.

product.name: Conciliación Bancaria (Bank Reconciliation)
product.description: A service that automates the reconciliation of payments by matching transactions with bank statements to simplify payment management and collection processes.

product.name: Débito Directo (Direct Debit)
product.description: A digital and automated service that simplifies recurring payment collections by transforming traditional automatic account payments into an API-driven process.

product.name: Payouts (Money Dispersal Service)
product.description: A service that facilitates sending payments to multiple bank accounts, such as suppliers, employees, or customers, through an automated and scalable API-driven system.

product.name: Programmable Business Accounts
product.description: Business accounts designed to receive high volumes of payments and automate reconciliation and financial-flow management.
